info.title: StoreIntel B2B & E-Commerce Intelligence API
info.description: Complete browserless B2B data enrichment API covering Shopify storefronts, Shopify App Store 1-star churn leads, Skool community MRR/ARR, website contacts & tech stacks, Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby jobs, Y Combinator founders, WordPress plugins, and Substack engagement.

get.description: Detects active Shopify theme, installed marketing/review apps, storefront emails, social links, pricing metrics, and public products.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Shopify store domain or URL (e.g. tentree.com)

get.description: Scrapes competitor Shopify App Store reviews filtered by star rating (1-5) and classifies merchant pain points.

parameters.name: app_slug
parameters.description: Shopify App handle or apps.shopify.com URL (e.g. klaviyo-email-marketing)

get.summary: Estimate Skool Community MRR & Creator Links
get.description: Extracts member counts, monthly subscription price, estimated MRR/ARR, owner name, and creator social URLs from Skool communities or the /discovery catalog.

parameters.name: slug_or_url
parameters.description: Skool slug (or 'discovery') or full skool.com URL

200.description: Estimated MRR/ARR and creator lead payload

get.summary: Extract Public Emails, Socials & Tech Stack
get.description: Fetches any public website and extracts visible contact emails, LinkedIn/X/GitHub/Instagram/YouTube profiles, and frontend tech stack signals.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public website domain or URL (e.g. resend.com)

200.description: Extracted emails, social links, and tech stack

get.summary: Fetch Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Jobs + Tech Stack
get.description: Queries public ATS job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, AshbyHQ) to extract open roles, salary ranges, and hiring B2B tech stack signals.

parameters.name: board_url
parameters.description: ATS job board URL or company slug (e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe)

200.description: Normalized ATS jobs & aggregated tech stack signals

get.summary: Extract Y Combinator Startup & Founders LinkedIn/X
get.description: Fetches Y Combinator startup batch, team size, website, tags, and individual founders with LinkedIn and X/Twitter URLs.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Y Combinator company slug or URL (e.g. supabase, stripe)

200.description: YC startup and founder social profiles

get.summary: Inspect WordPress Plugin Installs, Rating & Support
get.description: Queries the official WordPress.org Plugin API for active installs, downloads, support thread resolution rate, and commercial links.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: WordPress plugin slug or URL (e.g. woocommerce)

get.summary: Fetch Substack Author, Engagement & Recent Posts
get.description: Queries public Substack publication archives to calculate average reactions/comments and return author bio, X handle, and recent posts.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Substack subdomain or custom URL (e.g. pragmaticengineer)

200.description: Substack engagement averages and post list
